summary_markdown:
The conversation revolves around potential hardware upgrades for a device. The initial request was for an upgrade budget of approximately 1,000 EUR or 770 EUR, with potential future funding of 300–500 EUR next year.

[p1] questioned if the upgrade referred to a vehicle. [me] confirmed it was related to hardware/tech. 

Regarding the budget, [p1] stated that 'Diksha' believes all subscriptions are already covered under their allowance and agreed to check on this tomorrow. [me] suggested framing the expense as a necessary mid-range upgrade for Windows 11 compatibility, given that Windows 10 is no longer supported.

[me] provided a detailed cost breakdown for the 770 EUR option (Intel Core i9-14900K (~500), Asus MB (~170), Water Cooling (~100)), noting that existing DDR4 memory would be retained. [p1] agreed that 770 EUR was acceptable and unnecessary to pursue the higher 1,000 EUR option.
decisions: The hardware upgrade budget is set at 770 EUR.
action_items: Someone needs to confirm the allowance status for subscriptions/upgrades tomorrow.
